root_cause: Post-merge authority treated a timing-sensitive Supabase GitHub check as blocking production truth, while the provider runtime had already converged. The terminalizer also misclassified the runtime-backpressure configuration contract as unknown runtime and successor evidence had no explicit route back to the original merged PR.
prevention: Use bounded byte-for-byte Supabase Management API/CLI source parity as canonical production authority, keep GitHub provider checks non-blocking, allow successor replay only when current Supabase runtime is byte-equivalent to the target merge, route provider evidence to the replay target PR, and classify the exact runtime-backpressure config as verifier-only control-plane state.
